A backup camera, rear parking assistance, and automatic parking assistance provide additional support when maneuvering.  Remote start, keyless entry with push-button start, and a power liftgate make busy days easier. Power-folding heated mirrors, rain-sensing windshield wipers, HID headlights, and automatic high beams round out the equipment. A split-folding rear seat provides flexibility when you need additional cargo space for shopping, luggage, or weekend gear.
